prerequisite: User approved explicit common-cubic and reference-preserving regularized variants; original M0 contract remains frozen

variants.Original: Unchanged original CLS/AWF failure control; no repair or model qualification inferred
variants.CubicScaled: beta*(c4,c6,c7), original C(q), paired bounded inner destruction repair; reference-local candidate
variants.Regularized: CubicScaled minus prescribed gamma(x)*(S-Sref), same source repair and adapted baseline

constitutive_contract.reference: Incoming fixed Cartesian flow/normal, analytic Gref=us/(kappa*r) flow tensor normal; no current-state or hill-normal feedback
constitutive_contract.gamma: GammaUniform+GammaScale*kappa*us*physical wall distance; both coefficients fixed independently of evolving fields
constitutive_contract.field_coupling: Same selected Reynolds stress in momentum, turbulence production and total interface traction
constitutive_contract.required_evidence: All active/limiting branch tangents bounded over declared state envelope; a finite scan alone cannot certify that envelope
constitutive_contract.local_certificate_only: Common beta certificate at neutral reference does not qualify unrestricted hill states

source_contract.definitions: Dpos=Dpre*limiter/m; Epos=lambda*Epre; Cpos=Epos-Dpos; net k source=P_A-Dpos
source_contract.plateau: Original source and all its derivatives retained where every ray value has k/K>theta
source_contract.depletion: lambda<1 explicitly changes total dissipation and dependent epsilon trace; no double-counted redistribution
source_contract.baseline: Same repaired source at chi=0 and in EP transition; Original remains separate
source_contract.discrete_limit: Continuum quasi-positivity is not a high-order CG/IMEX positivity theorem

verification_gates.positivity: k>=0 at every declared source/mass/trace/transfer/native/dense finite evaluation set; outer k,epsilon and physical K strictly positive
verification_gates.covariance: Every finite evaluated covariance minimum >=-1e-10*K0 for the state range claimed as robust
verification_gates.source_mechanism: Depletion counterexample is recorded separately; passing its source balance cannot override a covariance failure
verification_gates.long_duration: Only complete predeclared time intervals in named flow-through and turnover units count; a solver stop leaves this gate failed
verification_gates.refinement: dt, p and mesh varied independently at fixed physical wall inputs; separate H/transition-width model studies

physical_validation.status: conditional; blocked until candidate and native long-time/refinement gates pass
physical_validation.backend: Current revised backend is native replicated dense CG; old CV strip trajectories do not qualify this wall representation

geometry.source: Cao--Tamura frozen geometry; sampler/sensor values are predeclared M8 wall-model choices

physical_validation.paired_required: Floor/hill pairs with identical physical inlet, surface, matching/sampling parameters, variant and gamma prescription
physical_validation.reserved_hill: All hill observations and dimensional holdouts; never select beta,gamma,H,width or inlet parameters by their scores
physical_validation.development: At least three unforced domain flow-throughs and two successive one-flow-through extensions; steady drift or preregistered stationary sampling required

physical_targets.height: physical global y/H, convert yprime=y-yh(x) only for observation mapping
physical_targets.weights: Use fixed CSV weights on visible source points. An unsupported probe prevents a complete-range score; any conditional subset metric must retain the omitted-weight/height coverage and be labelled separately, not substituted silently.
physical_targets.required_reporting: Every station, sign/bias, reverse flow, coverage and worst station; primary target not erased by a pooled mean.

physical_targets.metric: absolute predicted S minus reported scalar at x=0,yprime/H=0.25
physical_targets.reference: Same-surface flat reference at the paper reference station, same physical vertical yprime; not local normal distance or an x-local alternative.

physical_targets.observation: Ground-extrapolated mean U=0 dividing points. Reproduce with the declared CV2 operator; last two tail points linear extrapolation and last-three-point sensitivity where source method is unspecified. Publish wall-shear and finite-probe zero crossings separately.

physical_validation.missing_observations: Report pressure and wall stress as paired CFD observables where frozen dataset has no direct experimental counterpart; no invented data or pooled replacement scores
physical_validation.coverage: Preserve unsupported heights/weights and data uncertainties; incomplete ranges remain conditional

new_selection_policy: A passed M8 qualification receipt plus explicit candidate model identity is required; old original-first select/freeze commands are not invoked
failure_policy: Preserve every native failure report, accepted prefix, command and source hash. No rejected/unfinished trajectory enters developed averages or physical scores.
